_comment: Milestone F tool permission profiles (bd: shode-roadmap/C-F1, ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS 11.1). Read by scripts/permission-check.sh + CI drift check ONLY -- this file is NEVER preloaded into any agent context (token/run budget rule in the C-F1 brief). Two layers per agent type: (1) tool_grants = FACTS transcribed from each agents/<name>.md `tools:` frontmatter -- platform-enforced, a subagent without the tool physically cannot perform the action; CI asserts the `tools` array here matches the frontmatter verbatim, so this file cannot drift from reality. (2) policy = least-privilege caps NARROWER than the tool grants (write_code / deploy / deploy_prod), derived from capability ownership in references/registry/capabilities.json -- deny-by-default, advisory until a hook calls permission-check.sh on the hot path (see 15-sentinel-runtime-security.md SS enforceability). No agent is granted anything here that its frontmatter does not already allow.

_derivation.write_files: true iff `tools:` contains Write or Edit
_derivation.spawn: true iff `tools:` contains Task (see delegation.json for who may spawn whom)
_derivation.network: true iff `tools:` contains WebSearch or WebFetch
_derivation.write_code: policy layer: true only where the type's work includes producing code/test/infra files (build, verify incl. unit test+mutation and integration tests, operate incl. CI/IaC/observability, secure incl. security config+fixtures). plan and design write ARTIFACTS (outputs/**, docs, specs, design tokens), not code -- Write/Edit grant alone does not imply write_code. A type that merged roles with different caps carries a recorded _widening entry
_derivation.deploy: policy layer: operate only (capabilities.json: devops-deploy owner -- zero overlap rule); a reliability brief inherits the cap, see operate._widening
_derivation.deploy_prod: policy layer: subset of deploy; operate is the only deploy_prod=true type. permission-check.sh additionally requires the run_commands tool grant as a prerequisite, so a policy typo alone can never widen access

_retired: The router has no profile: it is the main session's output style, not a registered agent type, so it is never checked here. A retired name (a 4.0.0 agent id or a 3.x persona; see skills/discipline/shode-house-routing/ownership.md § Formerly) has no profile: it is UNKNOWN (exit 2), never an ALLOW.

_widening.from: staff-engineer (4.0.0 id, now build staff-grade brief): write_code=false; WebSearch removed
_widening.to: build: write_code=true for every brief; no network
_widening.reason: one profile per type; staff-grade briefs run in a code-writing type but lose their network tool (narrowing). Compensating controls: Scope Contract, threat-model gate and routed-only floor in the build body.

_widening.from: sre-engineer (4.0.0 id, now operate reliability mode): write_code=false, deploy=false, deploy_prod=false
_widening.to: operate: write_code=true, deploy=true, deploy_prod=true for every brief
_widening.reason: one agent type has one profile (the host gives no per-spawn policy); devops deploy mode needs the caps. Compensating controls: the operate body lets a reliability brief use deploy, prod or product-code actions only when its delegation explicitly authorises that action; the router pre-deploy-* gates and the R0 floor line apply to every brief; permission-check.sh still requires the Bash tool grant for deploy caps.
